whatAreAsBuiltSurveys.headline: What are As-built surveys?
whatAreAsBuiltSurveys.description: As-built surveys capture the true, current state of built environments by comparing actual field conditions with original designs. Using drones, LiDAR, and photogrammetry, we document infrastructure with centimeter-level accuracy, from the air—faster and safer than traditional methods.

items.title: Drone-Based Accuracy
items.description: We deploy UAVs equipped with LiDAR and photogrammetry to capture as-built conditions with high fidelity, minimizing human error and maximizing detail.

items.title: 3D Model Integration
items.description: Our data feeds directly into BIM and CAD environments, enabling seamless collaboration across engineering, design, and asset management teams.

items.title: Compliance Verification
items.description: We verify that structures and infrastructure meet design specifications, codes, and regulatory standards through precision spatial documentation.

items.title: Utility Mapping
items.description: Subsurface and surface utility lines are geo-referenced and recorded, creating a permanent digital record to reduce risk and support future development.

items.title: Progress & Handover Records
items.description: Capture every construction milestone with timestamped aerial data—perfect for reporting, stakeholder updates, and final handover documentation.

items.title: Smart Documentation
items.description: Interactive maps, 2D plans, and 3D datasets are delivered through secure portals, giving clients easy access to their as-built records from any device.

maxProductivityMinGuesswork.headline: Maximize Productivity. Minimize Guesswork.
maxProductivityMinGuesswork.description: At SmartGrid Surveying, we use UAVs equipped with high-precision sensors to collect 3D data, orthomosaics, and elevation models. This enables a complete digital replica of the site—ideal for validating engineering tolerances, assessing deviations, and facilitating smarter decision-making. Let data lead the way to profitability.

items.title: Construction Progress Verification
items.description: Verify that construction aligns with design specifications and identify deviations early.

items.title: Post-Construction Documentation
items.description: Create comprehensive records of completed structures for operations and maintenance.

items.title: Structural and Utility Audits
items.description: Conduct detailed inspections of existing structures and underground utilities.

items.title: Digital Twin Creation
items.description: Build precise digital replicas of physical assets for simulation and analysis.

items.title: BIM Integration & Model Validation
items.description: Validate and update Building Information Models with as-built data.

actionableInsights.headline: Smart Insights, Delivered Digitally!
actionableInsights.description: Pairing drone data with surveying techniques and GIS processing, we convert raw aerial data into actionable insights. Visualize deviations, flag inconsistencies, and bring clarity to your construction workflows—all in one seamless platform.

deliverables.headline: As-Built Survey Deliverables
deliverables.description: Complete as-built documentation for handover, verification and records:

items.title: As-Built Verification Reports
items.description: Documented comparison of constructed works against design, with evidence for engineering sign-off and records.

items.title: Progress Survey Reports
items.description: Scheduled captures that track construction progress against programme milestones and payment applications.

items.title: 3D As-Built Models
items.description: Spatially accurate models of constructed works ready for BIM integration and facilities management.

items.title: Orthomosaic Maps & Imagery
items.description: High-resolution, georeferenced aerial imagery documenting site conditions at every capture date.

items.title: Deviation & Quantity Analysis
items.description: Quantified differences between design and as-built surfaces, including earthwork and material quantities.

items.title: CAD Overlays & GIS Datasets
items.description: Design-versus-as-built overlays and geo-referenced datasets that plug straight into CAD and GIS workflows.
